_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: one-off English translations of nineteenth-century continental fiction: the German novel and novella of the 1870s-90s (Auerbach, Heyse, Spielhagen, E. Werner, Ossip Schubin, Franzos, Heimburg, Dahn, Reuter, Hausrath, Kohn, Gerstäcker, Sudermann's The Wish, Keller's Seven Legends, Thomas Mann's Royal Highness, 1916), Jókai by translators other than Bain, Bjørnson's Arne and In God's Way, Ingemann, Kraszewski, Couperus, Van Eeden's The Quest, De Coster's Ulenspiegel (Whitworth) and Flemish Legends, Blasco Ibáñez, Turgenev's Annouchka, Hugo's Toilers of the Sea (W. Moy Thomas), Dumas's Prussian Terror (R. S. Garnett), Paul de Kock, Laclos's Dangerous Connections (1812), Gourmont (Aldous Huxley's A Virgin Heart, 1921), Leblanc, Aimard, Pardo Bazán, Trueba, Guerrazzi, Strindberg's On the Seaboard, Cyrano de Bergerac's Voyage to the Moon (Lovell, 1687) and Tyssot de Patot's James Massey (Whatley, 1733). Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 42); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
